segments.name: Inspection and Mitigation
segments.description: Provides nondestructive testing and rope access inspection, plus mitigation work, to industrial and infrastructure clients to keep assets compliant and safe.
segments.evidence: Our Inspection and Mitigation services include Nondestructive Testing ("NDT") and Rope Access Technician ("RAT") solutions.

segments.name: Consulting Engineering
segments.description: Delivers engineering design, conformity assessment, utility, clean energy, data center, and environmental consulting services to public and private infrastructure clients.
segments.evidence: Our Consulting Engineering services include engineering design, conformity assessment, infrastructure engineering, building and technology design, environmental consulting, and materials engineering and testing.

segments.name: Geospatial
products: subscription-based geospatial software and analytic tools
segments.description: Collects and analyzes geospatial data and sells subscription software and project services to utilities, transportation, defense, and government clients.
segments.evidence: Our Geospatial services provide data collection, data analytics, and software solutions that support asset management and infrastructure planning.

revenueModel.text: Private and public-sector customers pay for recurring inspection, engineering, and geospatial services under time-and-materials, cost-plus, fixed-price, or unit-rate contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers enter into contracts with us with pricing terms that are either on a mix of time-and-materials, cost-plus, fixed-price, or unit-rate basis, with the majority of work performed under multi-year agreements or recurring customer relationships.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company completed a reorganization of its reportable segments to align with the service offerings of the combined entity.
